meta.name: Transcribe and summarize voice notes with Whisper, GPT-4.1, and Slack

parameters.content:
## Voice Notes (Speech-to-Text + LLM Cleanup/Summarizing)

Turns a raw voice recording into a clean, titled note with a short summary, action items and tags — with a human checkpoint after transcription and another before the final note is saved/sent.

### How it works
1. A voice note is uploaded (webhook, e.g. from a mobile shortcut / recording app), or the Manual Trigger is used for testing
2. Set - Config centralizes the transcription API URL/model, language, summary style and the notify channel
3. HTTP Request - Transcribe Audio sends the recording to a Speech-to-Text API (e.g. Whisper) and gets back the raw transcript
4. JS - Clean Transcript & Prepare LLM Input does light mechanical cleanup (whitespace, casing, word count) and builds the prompt input
5. The flow pauses (Wait) so the transcript can be reviewed/corrected before it's summarized — useful since STT can mishear names, numbers, jargon
6. Once approved, AI - Clean Up & Summarize Note (LLM chain) rewrites the transcript into clean prose and produces a title, summary, action items and tags
7. JS - Parse LLM Output & Build Note Payload turns that into a structured note
8. The flow pauses a second time (Wait) for a save/send confirmation, then posts the final note to Slack (swap for Notion/Evernote/email as needed)

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: your Speech-to-Text API (on 'HTTP Request - Transcribe Audio'), OpenAI (Chat Model) and Slack (chat:write)
3. Edit Set - Config: sttApiUrl, sttModel, language, summaryStyle, notifyChannel
4. Point the webhook trigger at wherever your recordings come from (mobile shortcut, Telegram/WhatsApp voice note, upload form)
5. Point the two Wait nodes' resume webhooks at your review UI's 'approve transcript' and 'save note' actions
6. Activate the workflow, or use the Manual Trigger to test end to end

### Requirements
- Speech-to-Text API access (e.g. OpenAI Whisper /v1/audio/transcriptions)
- OpenAI API key for the cleanup/summarize step
- Slack app/bot token with chat:write scope (or swap for your notes app of choice)

### How to customize
- Skip the transcript-review Wait for low-stakes notes and go straight to summarization
- Change summaryStyle in Set - Config (bullet points, one-paragraph, meeting-minutes format, etc.)
- Swap the final Slack node for Notion, Evernote, Google Docs, or an email digest

## 1. Trigger, Transcription & Mechanical Cleanup

Set - Config centralizes the STT API URL/model, language and downstream settings.

HTTP Request - Transcribe Audio sends the uploaded audio (binary) to the Speech-to-Text API and gets back a raw transcript string — this is the workflow's one external API call.

JS - Clean Transcript & Prepare LLM Input does the cheap, deterministic cleanup (trim/collapse whitespace, sentence casing, word count) that doesn't need an LLM, and packages everything the summarizer will need.

## 2. Human Review, then LLM Cleanup & Summary

Wait - For Transcript Review pauses the workflow so a person can fix any mis-heard names, numbers or jargon before the AI touches it — resumed via webhook once the transcript is approved (as-is or edited).

IF - Review Approved gates the rest of the flow. On approval, AI - Clean Up & Summarize Note (LLM chain) rewrites the transcript into clean prose and returns a structured title, summary, action items and tags.

JS - Parse LLM Output & Build Note Payload safely parses that JSON into the final note fields, falling back to the raw text if parsing fails.

## 3. Save/Send Confirmation & Delivery

Wait - For Save Confirmation pauses one more time before the note is actually saved/sent anywhere — a lightweight human checkpoint, resumed via webhook when the user hits 'Save'.

IF - Save Approved gates delivery: approved notes are posted by Slack - Send Voice Note Summary (swap for your notes app); declined ones land on Set - Discarded/Cancelled instead. Slack uses continueOnFail so a delivery hiccup doesn't fail the run.

parameters.text:
=You are a note-taking assistant. Rewrite the following voice-note transcript into clean, well-punctuated prose (fix filler words like 'um'/'uh', run-ons and obvious mis-transcriptions where the meaning is clear), then produce a short summary in this style: {{ $('JS - Clean Transcript & Prepare LLM Input').item.json.summaryStyle }}.

Transcript:
{{ $('JS - Clean Transcript & Prepare LLM Input').item.json.reviewedTranscript || $('JS - Clean Transcript & Prepare LLM Input').item.json.lightlyCleanedTranscript }}

Return ONLY a JSON object (no markdown fences, no commentary) with keys: title (short, a few words), cleanedText (the rewritten full note), summary (the short summary), actionItems (array of strings, empty if none), tags (array of short keyword strings).
